parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
The configuration content. You can pass in one of the following values:

The configuration content text. For the format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172319.html.
The Object Storage Service (OSS) address where the configuration file is stored.

You can specify up to 20 configurations in a single call
fields.help_zh:
配置内容，可以选择传入：

配置内容文本。格式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172319.html。
存储配置文件的阿里云对象存储（OSS）地址。

单次调用最多可填写20个配置信息
fields.name: content

fields.help_en:
The device ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135261.html operation to query device IDs in the instance.

You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call
fields.help_zh:
设备ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135261.html查询实例中的设备ID。
